name: artcraft
description: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers
one_liner: A desktop app where you build a scene out of 2D and 3D pieces first, like a stage set, and then generate the final AI image or video from that, instead of just typing a prompt and hoping.
buyer: A freelance illustrator or small animation studio who sells consistent-character storyboards and shots to indie game or ad clients, and needs AI output that doesn't drift between frames.
business_use_cases: A freelance concept artist uses it to pose the same character consistently across many shots for a client's pitch deck, something plain prompting can't reliably do.
A small ad agency builds and reuses a 3D 'virtual set' to generate multiple product shots in different compositions for a campaign, skipping a physical photo shoot.
An indie game studio storyboards cutscenes by blocking out camera angles and character poses before paying for final art.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a 'consistent character' asset pack and storyboarding service for indie game studios and ad agencies, charged per project.
Sell reusable 3D scene/location kits built in ArtCraft that other creators can drop their own characters into.

steal_this: Build one reusable virtual product-shot set in ArtCraft and sell small businesses a same-day package of product photos staged in it, no studio needed.
